01 / THE COFFEE PROGRAM

Two Distinct Worlds of Coffee Under One Historic Roof.

Whether you stop at Austin’s dedicated pour-over bar right at the entrance for single-origin filter releases, or ascend the grand staircase for a house-made Butterscotch or Pistachio Rosewater latte, every cup is built from scratch.
AUTHENTIC CAFÉ CAPTURE · SIGNATURE LATTE & STREUSEL MUFFIN
UPSTAIRS ESPRESSO BAR · SINCE 2017 DANDY BREEZE JERSEY MILK · OAT MILK (+$0.75)

Botanical Infusions, Culinary Syrups & Aromatic Garnishes

Every flavored latte at Coat Check Coffee has been crafted in-house from raw culinary ingredients since opening in 2017. Rather than commercial syrups, our baristas simmer real butter, piloncillo, and orange peel for our famous Butterscotch Latte; steep turmeric, chili de arbol, and hibiscus for our Ginger Latte; and finish drinks with aromatic citrus twists and floral dusts.

DAIRY PARTNER

Dandy Breeze & Kalona

Single-family grass-fed Jersey milk from Sheridan, IN & Kalona Supernatural Dairy.

ROASTING PARTNERS

Tome & Tinker Coffee

Indianapolis specialty roasters alongside guest lots from Drift Away, BrandyWine & Pettibone.

TEA CURATION

Spirit Teas & Recess

Single-origin Oolong Wuyishan, Yame Sencha, Recess Matcha & house herbal infusions.

AROMATIC FINISHING

Balanced Sweetness & Complexity

Regular quality-control cuppings and flavor brainstorming sessions ensure every drink balances espresso strength with subtle botanicals and a complementary citrus or spice garnish.

ENTRANCE FILTER BAR WED–FRI 7A–1P · SAT–SUN 8A–2P

Curated Single-Origin Pour-Over Menu

Right at the Athenaeum entrance, our dedicated pour-over bar serves rotating specialty lots brewed to order—from 72-hour anaerobic thermal-shock Castillo from Huila, Colombia to Coffee Blossom Washed Estate lots from Chikmagalur, India.

03 / THE KITCHEN & SCRATCH BAKERY

House-Made Butter Biscuits, Polish Bialys & Scratch Pastries.

Baked fresh daily inside the Athenaeum. From warm egg-soufflé breakfast sandwiches with house jalapeño jelly to traditional Polish flatbread bialys, biscuits & gravy, and flaky butter croissants.
SCRATCH MORNING PASTRY

Scratch Muffins, Croissants & Macarons

Prepared from scratch each morning—featuring butter croissants, chocolate croissants, streusel & blueberry muffins, macarons, cinnamon rolls, and baklava babka.

BAKED IN-HOUSE DAILY $3.00 – $6.00
THE ATHENAEUM COUNTER CASE

House-Made Butter Biscuits & Focaccia

Our kitchen pairs Becker Farms & Old Major sausage with fluffy egg soufflé and house jalapeño pepper jelly on warm butter biscuits or vegan focaccia.

BREAKFAST & LUNCH $5.00 – $13.00
PAIRINGS & SMALL PLATES

Polish Bialy Rolls & Whipped Schmears

Bialy is a Polish flatbread roll with a depressed center, similar to a bagel—served as savory breakfast sandwiches or with regular or vegan garden, lox, or garlic chive schmear.

1890s German Landmark Charm, Stained Glass & Community Seating.

THE ENTRANCE ARCHWAY

Das Deutsche Haus & Basile Theatre

Step beneath the limestone archway and vintage lantern of the historic Athenaeum into our welcoming counter and theatre lobby.

NATURAL LIGHT & HERITAGE

1890s Leaded Glass & Grand Staircase

Morning light filters through original leaded stained-glass windows across upstairs art displays, lounge couches, and laptop-friendly tables.

THE ORIGINAL COAT CHECK WINDOW

Vintage Wrought-Iron Medallion Bar

Built directly into the building’s historic coat-check alcove—an inclusive, proudly LGBTQ+ friendly and transgender safe space.

MASS AVE CULTURAL DISTRICT

Landmark 1898 Architecture

Enjoy indoor community seating, upstairs art exhibitions, or dog-friendly outdoor seating along East Michigan Street.

ATMOSPHERE & WORK

Cozy, Historic & Laptop-Friendly

Casual, quiet, and trendy setting with free Wi-Fi, ample upstairs seating, and rotating art on display—popular for breakfast, solo dining, and remote work.

INCLUSIVE COMMUNITY

Welcoming to Everyone

Proudly LGBTQ+ friendly and a transgender safe space. Family-friendly, good for kids, university students, groups, and tourists exploring Mass Ave.

ACCESSIBILITY & PETS

Wheelchair & Dog Friendly

Wheelchair-accessible entrance, wheelchair-accessible seating, and wheelchair-accessible & gender-neutral restrooms. Dogs are welcome in our outdoor seating area.

SERVICE & PAYMENTS

Dine-In, Patio & Takeaway

Dine-in, outdoor seating, takeaway, and onsite bar service (beer & cocktails). Accepts credit cards, debit cards, and NFC mobile payments ($10–$20 per person).

05 / ABOUT COAT CHECK COFFEE

A Family-Owned Counter Rooted in Local Craft & Historic Hospitality.

Opened in 2017 inside the landmark Athenaeum Foundation (Das Deutsche Haus) at the corner of Massachusetts Avenue and East Michigan Street, Coat Check Coffee was built on a simple conviction: specialty coffee and scratch baking should feel both adventurous and deeply welcoming.

Every element on our menu reflects Indiana’s agricultural and roasting community—from single-family grass-fed Jersey milk by Dandy Breeze (Tom & Sally Waitt in Sheridan, IN) and Kalona Supernatural Dairy, to equitable coffee partnerships with Tome Coffee, Tinker Coffee, Drift Away, BrandyWine, and Pettibone.
